g.text: USB POWER: NO ISOLATION / SHARED VBUS DETECTION

g.desc: USB POWER: NO ISOLATION / SHARED VBUS DETECTION

g.text: Existing R5/R6: EN and GPIO0 pull-ups to 3.3 V.

g.desc: Existing R5/R6: EN and GPIO0 pull-ups to 3.3 V.

g.text: R5/R6 remain required even without manual boot/reset jumpers.

g.desc: R5/R6 remain required even without manual boot/reset jumpers.

g.text: DTR RTS | EN GPIO0 (physical logic levels)

g.desc: DTR RTS | EN GPIO0 (physical logic levels)

g.text: Keep this ceramic-stable regulator with MLCC output capacitor C5.

g.desc: Keep this ceramic-stable regulator with MLCC output capacitor C5.

g.text: C5: 22uF 25V X5R Basic; account for DC-bias derating.

g.desc: C5: 22uF 25V X5R Basic; account for DC-bias derating.

g.text: Placement only: complete routing before ordering.

g.desc: Placement only: complete routing before ordering.

g.text: VBUS shared; one USB cable only

g.desc: VBUS shared; one USB cable only

g.text: U2/U4: VREGIN = VDD = VIO = +3V3; internal regulators bypassed.

g.desc: U2/U4: VREGIN = VDD = VIO = +3V3; internal regulators bypassed.

g.text: C7/C8 near U4 VDD/VREGIN; C9 near VIO.

g.desc: C7/C8 near U4 VDD/VREGIN; C9 near VIO.

g.text: Use esptool default DTR/RTS reset; disable terminal hardware flow control.

g.desc: Use esptool default DTR/RTS reset; disable terminal hardware flow control.

g.text: FLASHER1 D+/D- connect directly to U4; no external USB ESD array.

g.desc: FLASHER1 D+/D- connect directly to U4; no external USB ESD array.

g.text: WARNING: CONNECT ONLY ONE USB CABLE AT A TIME.

g.desc: WARNING: CONNECT ONLY ONE USB CABLE AT A TIME.

g.text: Both connector VBUS pins are directly tied to +5V.

g.desc: Both connector VBUS pins are directly tied to +5V.

g.text: No reverse-current protection, even with ports on the same PC.

g.desc: No reverse-current protection, even with ports on the same PC.

g.text: R14/R15 (22k/47k) feed both CP2102N VBUS sense inputs.

g.desc: R14/R15 (22k/47k) feed both CP2102N VBUS sense inputs.
